field.intro: How this field compares with all 58 women's Division 1 races since 2010/11, on a scale where 100 is the strongest of them.
items: The ten strongest runners averaged 1,017 World Athletics points. 6 were in the UK 5K top 100.
The 100th-best runner in the field scored 680 points, and 39 finishers were in the UK 5K top 1,000.
field.note: World Athletics points put any time at any distance on one scale (800 is about 15:03 for a man over 5K, 18:25 for a woman). They're adjusted for how much faster the same runners have become since 2016, so seasons compare fairly. This race isn’t on Power of 10, so runners were matched by name and a few may be missing.
